{"relevant": true, "severity": "critical", "message": "internal/httpx/logging.go logs all headers and the full request body to stdout. That writes Authorization/Cookie/API-key headers and bodies (passwords, tokens, PII) into logs, so anyone with log access, or any log aggregator, can replay sessions or harvest credentials. Fix: log only method, path, status, duration and a request ID; use a header allowlist (e.g. User-Agent, Content-Type) instead of dumping all; redact Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie and X-API-Key; skip bodies entirely, or log them only behind an explicit debug flag that is off by default, with size caps and field-level redaction. Also sanitize CR/LF in logged path values to prevent log injection."}
